newsitem.title: ITALY: Mafia boss suspected of being behind Calvi death.
newsitem.headline: Mafia boss suspected of being behind Calvi death.

text.p: Jailed mafia boss Pippo Calo is suspected by investigators of ordering the murder in 1982 of Italian banker Roberto Calvi, judicial sources said on Wednesday.
Investigating magistrate Mario Almerighi issued an arrest warrant for Calo, who is already serving a life sentence for ordering a 1984 train bombing which killed 16 people.
A warrant was also issued for the arrest of Flavio Carboni, a business associate of Calvi.

Calvi, known as "God's banker" because of his links with Vatican circles, was found hanging from a bridge in London in June 1982 with his pockets stuffed with bricks, in circumstances which have never been fully explained.
Calvi was chairman of the defunct Banco Ambrosiano at the time of his death.

A first inquest in London found that Calvi had committed suicide, but the dead banker's family appealed the ruling and a second hearing returned an open verdict. A court in Milan said in 1989 that Calvi had been murdered by persons unknown.

Calvi was believed to have agreed to travel to London with Carboni in a desperate attempt to raise funding for the stricken Ambrosiano, which collapsed with huge debts shortly after his death in one of the biggest frauds in Italian business history.
Calo, who has been in jail for 12 years, was one of the most feared members of the Corleone mafia clan and managed its interests in Rome.
Giovanni Falcone, a top Sicilian magistrate murdered in 1992, described Calo as "a man who commissioned murders and who was also a link between mafia criminals and white collar criminals."

Judicial sources said magistrates were also investigating allegations that Licio Gelli, the former head of the illegal Propaganda Due (P2) masonic lodge, and another mafia boss, Francesco Di Carlo, were implicated in the murder.
A former mafia gangster, Marino Mannoia, has alleged that Di Carlo throttled Calvi with his bare hands and then strung up his body under the bridge to make it look like a suicide.
